root_cause.text: The loop in af_alg_pull_tsgl lacks a check for non-zero page length (plen) before attempting to reassign pages, causing it to overrun the destination scatterlist when encountering zero-length entries.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds the condition `if (dst && plen)` to the reassignment block, explicitly preventing reassignment when the length is zero; the commit message states that the original loop "wasn't updated so it may try to reassign one more page than necessary."

The vulnerable construct (reassigning pages without checking plen>0) is not present because the condition `if (dst_offset >= plen)` at line 641 ensures that reassignments via `sg_set_page(dst + j, ...)` and `j++` only occur when `dst_offset < plen`.
